title: What fruit am I? Free fruit personality quiz — cv.cm
description: Free fruit quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're a strawberry, banana, apple, mango, pineapple, watermelon, lemon or peach, and what your fruit says about you. No sign-up.
lede: Sweet like a strawberry, zesty like a lemon or tough outside and soft inside like a pineapple? Answer 12 questions about your days, your friends and your style to find your fruit.
about: Fruits make easy personality symbols because everyone knows what they're like: strawberries are sweet, lemons are sharp, pineapples are spiky outside and sweet inside, watermelons mean summer and sharing. This quiz uses those everyday images, not any science, to match your personality with one of eight fruits.

Your result names your fruit, explains what it says about you and shows your scores for all eight. It's a fun quiz written for cv.cm, so read it lightly. If you like this kind of quiz, try the flower, spirit animal and aura color quizzes on this site.

faq.a: Strawberry, banana, apple, mango, pineapple, watermelon, lemon and peach.

faq.q: Is one fruit rarer than the others?
faq.a: Every fruit appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Is this a scientific personality test?
faq.a: No. It's a fun quiz written for cv.cm, and your answers stay in your browser.

strawberry.name: Strawberry
strawberry.body: You're sweet, romantic and a little playful. You notice the small, lovely things, you make people feel special and your warmth is hard to resist. You wear your heart on your sleeve, which is part of your charm.

banana.name: Banana
banana.body: You're easygoing, funny and practical. You don't make a fuss, you keep things simple and you're great company on a lazy day. People feel relaxed around you. When something matters, a little planning will take you far.

apple.name: Apple
apple.body: You're classic, dependable and grounded. You like routine, you keep your promises and people know exactly where they stand with you. You may not chase trends, but you never go out of style.

mango.name: Mango
mango.body: You're warm, generous and full of life. You love sunshine, good food and good company, and you share all three freely. Your enthusiasm lights up a room; pace yourself so you don't burn out.

pineapple.name: Pineapple
pineapple.body: You're confident and a bit spiky on the outside, sweet and loyal inside. You stand out, you say what you think and you don't let people push you around. The ones who get past your crown find a true friend.

watermelon.name: Watermelon
watermelon.body: You're fun, refreshing and social. You're happiest with a crowd, you love to share and you bring a summer feeling wherever you go. Friends can always count on you for a good time.

lemon.name: Lemon
lemon.body: You're zesty, honest and sharp-witted. You cut through nonsense, you get things done and your humor has a bite. Some find you strong at first, but your honesty is exactly why people trust you.

peach.name: Peach
peach.body: You're gentle, kind and soft-hearted. You notice who's left out, you speak softly and people feel safe around you. Your kindness is a quiet strength; make sure you get some of it back.
